Your colleagues drive their carts towards you. You scan the flowers that are on your list and place them in the right location. Got the hang of it? Then you learn how to drive on one of those carts yourself!

You’ll only work the morning shifts. So good! Your workday starts at 05:45h and you finish between 09:30h and 12:00h. Some days you’ll work a few more hours than others. But always between the 4 and 7 hours per day! Monday is the busiest day. It’s important that you can work that day for sure!

Where will you work
You’ll be working at the world’s largest flower auction site! Yes, really! That’s how massive the warehouse in Naa
